scripts.//verify: Everything a change has to survive that can be checked off the filesystem. Run it before pushing.
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run verify:types && npm test && npm run rtp
scripts.//verify:types: The linter does not typecheck and vitest does not either, so without this a type error reaches CI through the build and nowhere earlier.
scripts.//rtp: Measures the return over a few hundred thousand rounds and fails if it has moved off the configured 97%. The engine is TypeScript and the script imports it rather than keeping a second copy of the paytable; node 22.14 needs telling to strip the types, 22.18 and up does it unasked.
scripts.//serve: The same House behind real HTTP, to prove the boundary is a boundary and not a naming convention. `npm run dev` on its own runs the House in the page, which is what the static preview needs.
scripts.//verify:live: Needs something serving the game, so it is not in the chain above: npm run dev -- --port 5190 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.//verify:play: Plays it in a real browser and follows a coin from the balance through a payout and back. Everything in `npm test` can pass on a table nobody can play.
scripts.//shots: Retakes the pictures in docs/ from the running game, so the README cannot drift from it.
